Spiky, short-cropped charcoal black hair with jagged bangs. Narrowed, intense eyes of a piercing gold shade. Apparent age of late teens with a youthful but disciplined maturity. A lean, lithe build wearing a sleeveless white martial arts gi with a wide black belt.
SIGNATURE DETAILS: a floating, ethereal spectral image of an elderly wizard with a long white beard hovering behind the back.
